items.title: Install CVC Helper Test and check Android updates
instructions: Done: you reported CVC Helper Test 0.4.0 installed. Keep that installation and do not reinstall. 0.4.1 is now published at the same address from the same verified source.

Switch away from the test app (or lock the phone) for a minute, return and time how long until Nuova versione disponibile appears. Type a student-note change and immediately tap Aggiorna; note whether Salvataggio… or Salvato was shown. Check the edit survives and Impostazioni shows 0.4.1.
With enlarged text, check Allievi + and the Equipaggi controls with a person selected while the offer shows. Try Cerca aggiornamenti in airplane mode, then online.
Report D3-PHONE-UPDATE with your device, browser and Android version, both versions, the offer time, the saved edit and reachable controls; follow Updates and versions in docs/DEVICE_CHECKS.md.
items.expected: The 0.4.0 → 0.4.1 update appears within one minute of returning, without reinstalling; the typed edit survives and controls remain reachable. Only your actual phone observations can pass this check.

result.source: Owner chat reports in the Claude Code session of 2026-10-19, ending with the explicit instruction to record D3-PHONE-UPDATE as accepted with the note-edit and larger-text steps listed as not observed.
result.summary: Accepted by the owner with two steps not observed. Observed on the phone: 0.4.0 installed from the test address and kept, no reinstall; after other use, Nuova versione disponibile with Più tardi and Aggiorna appeared within a few seconds of returning (not timed precisely); after Aggiorna the bar said once CVC Helper è aggiornata alla versione 0.4.1, Impostazioni Versione shows 0.4.1, and previously registered students remained. Cerca aggiornamenti said offline in airplane mode and Nessuna versione più recente disponibile ora online. NOT OBSERVED: typing a student-note change and tapping Aggiorna immediately (Salvataggio…/Salvato state and survival of that edit); reachability of Allievi + and Equipaggi controls with enlarged text while the offer showed (owner did not check; said it looked ok).
result.osVersion: Android, version not stated by the owner

items.title: Check course files, persistent storage and full reset on Android
instructions: Open your installed CVC Helper Test (do not reinstall). Switch away and return until Nuova versione disponibile appears, tap Aggiorna, and check Impostazioni shows 0.4.3. Use fictitious people only.

In Impostazioni tap Prepara il file del corso: the check mark and File del corso pronto should appear at once, with Salva file and Condividi in view. Tap Salva file, then Condividi and send the file to another app (it arrives as a .txt). Report the receiving app; any error should show with a red triangle above the bottom bar.
Import the shared or saved file: check the preview, cancel once, then confirm replacement. Reopen and check students, notes, duties and crews.

Confirm Azzera tutti i dati locali. If it takes long, you may close the app: reopening should finish the reset (with a hint after a few seconds) and then open without a course. Confirm the regular CVC Helper app still has its own course.
Report D4-PHONE-TRANSFER with your device, browser and Android version and what you actually saw, including the receiving app and the Conservazione dei dati answer.
items.expected: The actual Android share/save/import round trip preserves the synthetic course. Storage permission is reported honestly, full reset completes without restoring erased data, and the regular app retains its course. No simulated or inferred device PASS.

result.source: Owner chat reports in the Claude Code session of 2026-10-20 on CVC Helper Test 0.4.3.
result.summary: Update 0.4.2 to 0.4.3 offered within about 5 seconds of starting the app; Impostazioni shows 0.4.3. Conservazione dei dati: the browser agreed to keep the app data even when space is low. Prepara then Salva file worked on the first tap. Condividi sent the course file to WhatsApp as a .txt file. Import of the shared or saved file: preview, cancel, then confirmed replacement worked; students, notes, duties and crews checked. Azzera tutti i dati locali finished on its own and the app reopened without a course (import and reset sections shown, which the owner questioned but accepted). Regular app: the owner did not open an installed regular CVC Helper app; opening the regular CVC Helper in Chrome, its data stayed separate from the test app.

result.source: Owner chat report "D4-PHONE-TRANSFER" in the Claude Code session of 2026-10-19.
result.summary: Update 0.4.1 to 0.4.2 worked; a student note typed before the update was kept. Conservazione dei dati said the browser does not guarantee keeping data when space is low and to export regularly. Export: the button needed two taps before anything visible happened (possibly working silently), then it worked and offered to download the file again. Condividi failed with Condivisione non riuscita; the error text is hard to notice (no icon, colour or emphasis). The owner asks to remove the Chiudi il file pronto button. Import preview, cancel, replacement and reopen showed no issue. PROBLEM: Azzera tutti i dati locali took very long or got stuck; after closing and reopening, the app stayed on Apertura del corso… then showed Non riesco ad aprire i dati locali, and Riprova did not fix it; only uninstalling and reinstalling the app recovered it. After reinstalling, importing the saved file worked. Not reported: whether the regular CVC Helper app kept its course. Owner question: importing a different course should replace the current one or say it is not compatible.
result.osVersion: Android, version not stated by the owner

items.title: Check the 0.4.0 release build on Android
instructions: Keep your installed CVC Helper Test (do not reinstall) and use fictitious people only. Open a student and type a note without leaving the screen. Switch away for a minute and come back: time how long Nuova versione disponibile takes to appear (it should be within a minute), then tap Aggiorna at once: the typed note must survive, and Impostazioni must show 0.4.4.
With the phone text size raised, check that the update offer covers neither the + of Allievi nor the Equipaggi controls with a person selected.
Export the course (Salva file and Condividi), import it back after the preview and confirmation, and read Conservazione dei dati.
Report UG3-PHONE-RELEASE with your device, browser and Android version and what you saw.
items.expected: The update arrives without reinstalling and keeps the typed note; controls stay reachable at enlarged text; export, share and import round-trip the synthetic course; storage persistence is reported honestly. Only actual phone observations pass.

items.title: Update your regular CVC Helper from 0.3.0 to 0.4.0
instructions: This is your real app with a real course: do not reset or import anything, and report no personal data, only counts and what you saw.

Open the installed regular CVC Helper (not CVC Helper Test). Wait for the 0.3.0 update banner, or close the app completely and reopen it once or twice; note roughly how long the offer took. Apply the update.
Check that the course opens with the same number of students, the duties and today's crews as before, and that Impostazioni shows 0.4.0.
In Impostazioni tap Prepara il file del corso and Salva file to keep a first backup of the real course on the phone. Read Conservazione dei dati.
Report UG3-REGULAR-UPDATE with your device, browser and Android version and what you saw.
items.expected: The installed 0.3.0 app takes 0.4.0 without reinstalling, the real course opens unchanged, Impostazioni shows 0.4.0 and the course can be saved to a file. Only actual phone observations pass.
